title: Multimodal integration using a machine learning approach facilitates risk stratification in HR+/HER2- breast cancer.
authors: Zhang, Hang; Yang, Fan; Xu, Ying; Zhao, Shen; Jiang, Yi-Zhou; Shao, Zhi-Ming; Xiao, Yi
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习整合多组学数据预测HR+/HER2-乳腺癌复发风险，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hormone receptor-positive (HR+)/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HER2-) breast cancer is the most common type of breast cancer, with continuous recurrence remaining an important clinical issue. Current relapse predictive models in HR+/HER2- breast cancer patients still have limitations. The integration of multidimensional data represents a promising alternative for predicting relapse. In this study, we leverage our multi-omics cohort comprising 579 HR+/HER2- breast cancer patients (200 patients with complete data across 7 modalities) and develop a machine-learning-based model, namely CIMPTGV, which integrates clinical information, immunohistochemistry, metabolomics, pathomics, transcriptomics, genomics, and copy number variations to predict recurrence risk of HR+/HER2- breast cancer. This model achieves concordance indices (C-indices) of 0.871 and 0.869 in the train and test sets, respectively. The risk population predicted by the CIMPTGV model encompasses those identified by single-modality models. Feature analysis reveals that synergistic and complementary effects exist in different modalities. Simultaneously, we develop a simplified model with a mean area under the curve (AUC) of 0.840, presenting a useful approach for clinical applications.
abstract_zh: 激素受体阳性（HR+）/人表皮生长因子受体2阴性（HER2-）乳腺癌是最常见的乳腺癌类型，持续复发仍是重要的临床问题。目前针对HR+/HER2-乳腺癌患者的复发预测模型仍存在局限性。整合多维数据代表了预测复发的一种有前景的替代方法。在本研究中，我们利用包含579例HR+/HER2-乳腺癌患者（其中200例患者具有7种模态的完整数据）的多组学队列，开发了一种基于机器学习的模型，即CIMPTGV，该模型整合了临床信息、免疫组织化学、代谢组学、病理组学、转录组学、基因组学和拷贝数变异，以预测HR+/HER2-乳腺癌的复发风险。该模型在训练集和测试集中分别达到了0.871和0.869的一致性指数（C-indices）。CIMPTGV模型预测的风险人群涵盖了单模态模型所识别的人群。特征分析显示，不同模态之间存在协同和互补效应。同时，我们开发了一个简化模型，其平均曲线下面积（AUC）为0.840，为临床应用提供了一种实用方法。
